notes: Breadboard drawing has the rows labelled j-f in the top half and e-a in the bottom half; the catalogue names the top half bank 't' (rows a-e) and bottom half 'b' (rows f-j). I used the catalogue naming: the image's top half = bank 't', the image's bottom half = bank 'b'. Exact row letters are approximate; only the column-bank strips matter electrically.

Column numbers estimated from the image: LED anodes (long, bent leg) at columns 7,10,13,16,19,22 and cathodes at 8,11,14,17,20,23. Resistors bridge the centre gap in the same column as each anode; blue wires land in the lower half of the same column.

Black jumper wires join each LED cathode column to the top negative (GND) rail (tn); the exact rail hole numbers are approximate. The rail is connected to Arduino GND by a dark wire (drawn at the GND pin next to pin 13, mapped to GND.1).
Blue wires: pin 7 -> col 7, pin 6 -> col 10, pin 5 -> col 13, pin 4 -> col 16, pin 3 -> col 19, pin 2 -> col 22.
Resistor value 220 ohm per the manual; LEDs are red per the image. Not written as a repeat because each copy's breadboard holes differ.
